limitations: Credentials, raw prompts, machine paths, Session IDs, Run IDs, and API keys are intentionally excluded.
Usage and cost fields remain disabled until their provider semantics are independently verified.
Grok 1.x rejects non-empty additionalDirectories on session/resume; Rovai therefore sends an empty array and relies on real post-resume product smokes rather than claiming that Resume updates roots.
Compaction detection remains best-effort and fail-closed; the 1.0.5 continuation revision did not re-run the acceptance-only debug-arm compaction smoke.
Grok ignores ACP Session mcpServers; External MCP therefore continues to use a private process plugin-dir and rotates Host compatibility when the full server set changes.

Account cached-token authentication was not exercised because this host has no existing Grok login; health and AgentRun select only advertised non-interactive methods and never initiate interactive login.
macOS x64 and Windows x64 remain not qualified until their own target-host evidence is recorded.
